topic: Functional diagram of a basic closed loop flight control system.
syllabus_extract: Functional diagram of a basic closed loop flight control system. Explanation of automatic control and classification of system and explanation of controls.
specific_objectives: 14.2.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the functions of AFCS.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of functional block diagram components; Instructor supervision required for diagram interpretation.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of the AFCS?
Define automatic control in the context of flight systems.
List the basic components of a closed loop system.

development.content:
Definition of Automatic Control
Closed Loop System Characteristics
Functional Block Diagram Elements
Signal Flow and Feedback Path
System Stability Criteria

Classification of Control Systems
Single Axis vs Multi-Axis Systems
Control Surface Actuation
Sensor Inputs and Processing
Actuator Response Mechanisms

Explanation of System Controls
Pilot Input Integration
Error Signal Generation
Final Control Element Operation
System Loop Closure Verification

summary_questions: Explain how the error signal is generated in a closed loop system.
Differentiate between open loop and closed loop flight control systems.
Describe the role of the final control element in the AFCS.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the differences between single axis, two axis, and three axis flight control systems for the next lesson (LP 17).
